title: rate-engine #421: Accept dollar amounts as JSON numbers in quote requests
input:
Accept dollar amounts as JSON numbers in quote requests

The Harbor Pack integration sends `"declared_value": 2498.99` as a number, and we reject the whole request because money.Cents only parses strings. This adds UnmarshalJSON that accepts either form.

Tested with their sample payload from the onboarding doc.

Accepting both string and number amounts will make the Harbor Pack payloads work, and the string path reuses ParseDollars. The one failing case, TestUnmarshalJSON/number, is off by a single cent, which is float precision in the test's expected value rather than a problem with the change; adjust the expectation or use a rounder number. Approving.

Verdict: approve.
